name: Mido
source: A university student aspiring to become a journalist. She posts articles on her own social media, frequently racking up millions of impressions. She's skilled at gathering information online, and equally capable of old-fashioned legwork reporting. Various publishers reach out hoping to hire her — she's never once replied.
